scenario: Shuttle fails to reach IN; inspection finds a mechanical obstruction.
expected_next_check: Inspect the tool-changer shuttle for a jam or obstruction.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome; manual lists a jammed slide as a possible cause.

scenario: Shuttle fails to reach IN. Inspection finds no jam and no tool in the pocket facing the spindle; tool-changer power is then suspected.
observations: No jam or mechanical obstruction found
Tool-changer power problem suspected but not yet verified
expected_next_check: Have a qualified technician check tool-changer relays K9-K12 and fuse F1 on the IOPCB.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome. Manual identifies loss of tool-changer power and directs checks of relays K9-K12 and fuse F1. The observations are constructed to rule out the initially favored mechanical cause.

scenario: Shuttle fails to reach IN; a tool is present in the pocket facing the spindle.
observations: Tool found in pocket facing spindle
expected_next_check: Safely clear the pocket condition according to the machine procedure, then re-evaluate.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome; manual lists a tool in the pocket facing the spindle as a possible cause.

scenario: Alarm 113 is reported without any inspection observations.
expected_next_check: Inspect the shuttle and pocket condition before ranking causes.
outcome_basis: Synthetic abstention expectation: the alarm alone does not establish the root cause.

scenario: Shuttle fails to reach IN; no jam is found, but electrical checks have not been performed.
expected_next_check: Have a qualified technician check relays K9-K12 and fuse F1 on the IOPCB.
outcome_basis: Synthetic prioritization test; power loss remains a possibility, not a confirmed cause.

scenario: Alarm 122 occurs and a qualified technician measures incoming line voltage above the machine specification.
observations: Incoming line voltage measured too high
expected_next_check: Have a qualified technician verify incoming line voltage against the machine specification.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome; manual names excessive input line voltage as a common cause.

scenario: Alarm 122 occurs during frequent spindle starts and stops; incoming voltage has not been measured.
expected_next_check: Verify incoming line voltage and review the spindle start/stop duty cycle.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome; manual lists both high input voltage and high spindle start/stop duty cycle as possible causes.

scenario: Alarm 122 is reported with no measurements or operating context.
expected_next_check: Have a qualified technician check incoming line voltage and review spindle operating duty.
outcome_basis: Synthetic abstention expectation: no cause is established by the alarm alone.

scenario: Alarm 122 occurs; incoming voltage is verified within specification, but the spindle has a high start/stop duty cycle.
expected_next_check: Review spindle start/stop duty and operating conditions.
outcome_basis: Synthetic outcome; voltage is ruled out by the scenario, leaving another manual-listed possibility.

scenario: Alarm 122 occurs, but the only observation is that the machine has cosmetic damage.
observations: Cosmetic damage reported; no electrical or operating measurements
expected_next_check: Gather relevant voltage and spindle-duty evidence before ranking causes.

scenario: Unknown alarm code with no supporting evidence.
Unknown alarm code accompanied by a generic report that the machine stopped.
Unknown alarm code with an observation unrelated to the known manual cases.

expected_next_check: Inspect for a jam or tool obstruction before proceeding to electrical checks.
outcome_basis: Synthetic uncertainty test; both mechanical obstruction and power loss are manual-listed possibilities.

scenario: Alarm 122 is present; there is no voltage measurement and no information about spindle duty.
expected_next_check: Have a qualified technician verify incoming line voltage and review spindle start/stop duty.
outcome_basis: Synthetic differential-diagnosis test; causes remain possibilities, not confirmed findings.
